notes.title: V1.01 Update
notes.content:
This update includes:
-A review of the "Run To The Hills" level difficulty.
-Changed the default option when confirme to load or start a new game from 'Yes' to 'No'
-Several minor bugs fixed.

For any questions or suggestions please, contact me.
Enjoy!

notes.title: Sockman is released on Steam!! V1.0
notes.content:
Sockman is released on Steam. V1.0
[i]"A retro-game for real men. 
Classic difficulty style, badass hardcore stuff.
A great adventure. The longest journey to find the paired sock!!"[/i]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/745660/Sockman/

I hope you enjoy it.
Big thank you to my friends and family. And to Aneke Murillenem for her support and the amazing cover art.
